paper.title_en: Einstein Telescope: the triangle in a network and the impact of the relative orientation of detectors
paper.abstract_en: The geometrical configuration of the Einstein Telescope (ET) gravitational-wave observatory is one the most important design choices to be made for this future scientific facility. Two baseline configurations are currently being considered, a single triangle or 2 distant L-shaped detectors tilted by about $45^{\circ}$. In this document we present a study of the scientific performance of the ET baseline configurations in both stand-alone mode and in the presence of either an L-shaped Cosmic Explorer detector with 40-km long arms located in the United States or the existing LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA network. We also include in the study an alternative ET configuration, which is currently not being considered and consists of a triangle plus a distant L-shaped detector. We find that in stand-alone mode this alternative configuration performs significantly better than the other two in both the compact binary coalescence and stochastic gravitational wave background scientific cases. The differences in performance between the ET configurations are reduced in the presence of the considered, additional non-ET detectors. We also show that the impact of possible correlated noise in co-located detectors on the stochastic gravitational-wave background performance can be addressed with the addition of extra detectors. Finally, we study the impact on the ET scientific performance of the relative orientation of the future detectors in the network. We find that, while the configurations that include a triangular ET detector are basically insensitive to this orientation, a balanced compromise for the ET configuration consisting of two L-shaped detectors could be represented by a tilt angle between the two detectors of about $30^{\circ}$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究了Einstein Telescope的几何构型及其在引力波探测网络中的相对取向对科学性能的影响，涉及随机引力波背景等核心主题，理论深度和方法论严谨性信号较好，具有新颖性，且摘要清晰，元数据质量尚可，因此推荐阅读。
decision.title_zh: 爱因斯坦望远镜：网络中的三角形构型及探测器相对取向的影响
decision.abstract_zh: 爱因斯坦望远镜（ET）引力波天文台的几何构型是这一未来科学设施最重要的设计选择之一。目前正在考虑两种基线构型：单个三角形，或两个相距遥远、倾斜约$45^{\circ}$的L形探测器。在本文中，我们研究了ET基线构型在独立运行模式下，以及在存在位于美国的40公里臂长的L形宇宙探索者探测器或现有LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA网络的情况下的科学性能。我们还在研究中纳入了一种替代的ET构型，该构型目前未被考虑，由一个三角形加上一个相距遥远的L形探测器组成。我们发现，在独立运行模式下，这种替代构型在致密双星并合和随机引力波背景科学案例中均显著优于其他两种构型。在存在所考虑的额外非ET探测器的情况下，ET构型之间的性能差异减小。我们还表明，同址探测器中可能存在的相关噪声对随机引力波背景性能的影响，可以通过增加额外探测器来解决。最后，我们研究了网络中未来探测器相对取向对ET科学性能的影响。我们发现，虽然包含三角形ET探测器的构型基本上对这种取向不敏感，但对于由两个L形探测器组成的ET构型，一个平衡的折衷方案可能是两个探测器之间的倾斜角约为$30^{\circ}$。
